verdict.rationale: Reclaim's docs say Focus Time uses AI to "flexibly defend" a weekly focus goal. Habits "flex around your schedule and adapt as things come up", and Reclaim "automatically schedules and reschedules events… when conflicts come up". When a meeting overbooks a lower-priority smart event, it moves to "the next best time", governed by P1–P4 priorities and optional locks. Community users confirm habits auto-scheduled into their week, though one hands-on report found habits only move after a Yes/Maybe RSVP on the conflicting event. That is a usage caveat, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that Focus Time blocks are rescheduled on conflict, documentation of what happens when no alternative slot exists (whether the block is dropped).
